methods.label: Two-point graphing
methods.explanation: The graph of a linear function is a straight line, and two points determine a straight line. When $x=0$, $y=-1$; when $x=1$, $y=1$. Therefore, use $(0,-1)$ and $(1,1)$.
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 8 linear-function graphing and elementary substitution.
